x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Database Manager: A tool managing SQL databases and parsing SQL text.
    Version: 0.9.2
    Build date: 2026-11-27 03:29:59 UTC

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --working-dir
options.description: Working directory for the command. Defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to the configuration file.

options.name: --dialect
options.description: SQL dialect to use.

commands.name: parse-files
commands.description: Parse SQL files and emit the results to JSON files.

options.name: --output-pattern
options.description: Output file pattern for parsed results. Use '{fileName}' to include the original file name. [default: {fileName}.parsed.json]

options.name: --include-meta
options.description: Include non-SQL information in the parsed output. [default: False]

options.name: --file-exists-action
options.description: Action to take if the output file already exists. Options: Skip, Rename, Overwrite, Error. [default: Skip]

arguments.name: FILES
arguments.description: List of SQL files to parse.

commands.name: parse-definition
commands.description: Parse the database definition from the files indicated in the configuration and write it to a JSON file.

options.name: --relaxed
options.description: Enable relaxed parsing mode. [default: False]

options.name: --include-meta
options.description: Include non-SQL information in the parsed output. [default: False]

options.name: --include-raw-text
options.description: Include raw SQL text in the parsed output. [default: False]

options.name: --include-source-ref
options.description: Include source reference information in the parsed output. [default: False]

options.name: --file-exists-action
options.description: Action to take if the output file already exists. Options: Skip, Rename, Overwrite, Error. [default: Error]

arguments.name: OUTPUT_PATH
arguments.description: Output file path for the parsed definition.

commands.name: format-sql
commands.description: Format SQL files using the specified configuration.

options.name: --output-pattern
options.description: Output file pattern for formatted SQL files. Use '{fileName}' to include the original file name.

options.name: --no-backup
options.description: Do not create backup files when overwriting existing files. [default: False]

options.name: --file-exists-action
options.description: Action to take if the output file already exists. Options: Skip, Rename, Overwrite, Error. [default: Overwrite]

options.name: --strict
options.description: Enable strict mode for loading the database definition. [default: False]

options.name: --definition-file
options.description: Path to a pre-parsed definition JSON file to use for formatting. If not provided, the definition is loaded from the filesystem.

arguments.name: FILES
arguments.description: List of SQL files to format.

commands.name: download-schema
commands.description: Download the database schema using the specified configuration.

commands.name: compute-changes
commands.description: Compute changes based on the current database state and write them to an SQL script file.

options.name: --file-exists-action
options.description: Action to take if the output file already exists. Options: Skip, Rename, Overwrite, Error. [default: Rename]

arguments.name: OUTPUT_PATH
arguments.description: Output file path for the computed changes.

commands.name: validate-config
commands.description: Validate the configuration and optionally print it to the console.

options.name: --print-config
options.description: Print the loaded configuration to the console. WARNING: The printed configuration is not necessarily a valid configuration file and may omit certain properties or include properties in a different format than expected in a config file. This flag is intended for debugging purposes only. [default: False]

options.name: --strict
options.description: Validate the configuration assuming strict mode will be enabled. [default: False]
